facts.fact: StackAdapt's research found that 83% of marketers have added channels to their media mix in the past two to three years.
facts.quote: 83% of marketers have added channels to their media mix in the past two to three years

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's report, 45% of top-performing marketers have added three or more channels to their media mix.
facts.quote: Forty-five percent of top-performing marketers have added three or more channels to their media mix

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's report, top performers are defined as marketers who report stronger year-over-year performance.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's AI Delegation Gap report found that 62% of marketers reported spending less time on manual optimization thanks to AI.
facts.quote: 62% of marketers reported spending less time on manual optimization thanks to AI.

facts.fact: The State of Programmatic Advertising 2027 report found that 79% of marketers agree AI delivers value when the underlying data and measurement are connected and trusted.
